digest.en: Russia and the US are at odds over Ukraine arms sales after a tense meeting in Manila. Meanwhile, hundreds are hospitalized in Japan due to a severe heatwave, while China's live-fire drills in the Taiwan Strait are raising regional tensions.
digest.hi: भारत ने ब्रिक्स देशों में तलाशे नए बाजार, जेनेरिक दवाओं के लिए 3.5 गुना बड़ा बाजार। इस कदम से भारत के जेनेरिक दवाओं के निर्यात में वृद्धि होने की संभावना है। भारत सरकार ने ब्रिक्स देशों में जेनेरिक दवाओं के बाजार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए कई पहल की हैं।

articles.title: Faishal Ibrahim’s resignation needs more transparency for proper closure
articles.summary: Without more information, the public has made all sorts of speculation and ill-informed judgement – the most damaging of which are not about the nature of the minister’s interactions with a woman, says veteran newspaper editor Han Fook Kwang. Faishal Ibrahim’s resignation needs more transparency for proper closure.

articles.title: China begins two days of live-fire drills in Taiwan Strait
articles.summary: The news comes a day after ‌talks between U. S. Secretary ‌of State ⁠Marco Rubio and ⁠Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on a range of issues, including ​democratically-governed Taiwan, which China ‌claims as its own territory. China begins two days of live-fire drills in Taiwan Strait.

articles.title: Hundreds hospitalised in Japan heatwave 'disaster'
articles.summary: A total 453 people had hospital treatment for heat-related issues on Wednesday, the most since records began in 2010, the Tokyo Fire Department said. Emergency callouts were also at the highest level since at least 1963. Hundreds hospitalised in Japan heatwave 'disaster'.

articles.title: Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea
articles.summary: Islamabad has condemned attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi-flagged vessels in the Red Sea. It also warned that any aggressive actions toward Pakistan-flagged vessels or the country's maritime interests would be regarded as a “grave threat” that may result in “lawful use of force.” Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea.

articles.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify. On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk.

articles.title: Iran urged to stop protest-related executions
articles.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators on Thursday called for Iran to immediately halt the execution of 10 men who took part in a protest in the central city of Isfahan earlier this year, warning that some of their relatives have already been called for final visits. Iran urged to stop protest-related executions.

articles.title: Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns
articles.summary: Food security and child nutrition have improved across the Gaza Strip largely due to a scale-up in humanitarian assistance and commercial traffic, but progress remains fragile and could quickly reverse without sustained access, funding and recovery support. Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns.

articles.title: Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls
articles.summary: As the Iran-US war continues, the key question remains unanswered about how shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will be managed in future – although the UN has reiterated that charging tolls for safe passage runs contrary to international law. Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls.

articles.title: No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said following talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov that the United States remains prepared to help broker an end to Russia's war in Ukraine but that fresh proposals would be needed after previous peace ideas failed. No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War.

articles.title: Hasina’s return from India would imperil Bangladesh’s sovereignty
articles.summary: To say Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina left office in disgrace would be an understatement by any political measure. articles.title: Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them
articles.summary: As battlefield injuries mount from a long-running war, Ukrainian companies are racing to meet a high demand for prosthetic limbs. One start-up, Allbionics, is making sophisticated prosthetics that it offers to patients at no cost, with the help of government support and private donations. Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them.

articles.title: The real reasons behind Zelensky’s unpopular military purge
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky recently made the controversial decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, his minister of defense. Fedorov, admired both by Ukrainian troops and Western allies, was at the forefront of Ukraine’s increasing technological innovations in the war against Russia. According to Fedorov, however, tension began to emerge over his own desire to replace General [] The post The real reasons behind Zelensky’s unpopular military purge.

articles.title: Indonesia shouldn’t bet its nickel future on China’s EVs alone
articles.summary: Indonesia is building a battery industry and an EV ecosystem as part of its broader nickel downstreaming agenda. The objective is that downstreaming should not stop at smelters. It must move deeper into industrial components, machinery, batteries and, eventually, electric vehicles. Indonesia’s largest battery industrial hub reflects this ambition. But the battery industry itself is [] The post In Indonesia shouldn’t bet its nickel future on China’s EVs alone.

articles.title: Why Europe needs Pakistan now more than ever
articles.summary: Europe’s strategic environment is changing rapidly. Russia’s war in Ukraine, instability across the Middle East, growing insecurity in the Red Sea and renewed concerns over supply-chain resilience have prompted the European Union (EU) to reassess its external partnerships. At the same time, competition between the EU’s Global Gateway initiative and China’s Belt and Road Initiative [] The post Why Why Europe needs Pakistan now more than ever.

articles.title: Nonproliferationists demand Congress reject Trump-Saudi nuke deal
articles.summary: Nonproliferation experts are raising alarms after Reuters reported that President Donald Trump’s administration plans to ask Congress to approve a deal that could allow Saudi Arabia to develop nuclear weapons. According to Reuters, an agreement crafted by the Trump administration would allow the US to share nuclear power technology with the Saudis without proper safeguards that “would stop materia Nonproliferationists demand Congress reject Trump-Saudi nuke deal.

articles.title: House approves GOP-supported US-Israel military integration
articles.summary: The Republican-controlled US House of Representatives voted Wednesday in favor of a record $1.15 trillion military spending authorization bill containing a highly controversial provision to increase cooperation between the US and Israeli armed forces. House lawmakers voted 219-206, almost entirely along party lines, to pass HR 8800, the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for fiscal year 202 House approves GOP-supported US-Israel military integration.

articles.title: US may sanction China’s Moonshot for distilling Anthropic’s Fable
articles.summary: Washington is threatening to impose sanctions on Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) companies for building their models by distilling outputs from American AI systems, saying it has found evidence of large-scale, covert theft of proprietary US technology. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington would investigate whether China’s leading open-weight models had been built by illegally [ US may sanction China’s Moonshot for distilling Anthropic’s Fable.

articles.title: Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike
articles.summary: Iran has executed Mehdi Khaneki, a young man convicted on charges tied to anti-government protests that swept across the country in January. The execution came as some 1,500 death row inmates at the prison continued a hunger strike demanding an end to executions. Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike.

articles.title: Canada cancels joint bridge-opening celebration with US amid trade tensions
articles.summary: The ribbon-cutting celebration of the Gordie Howe International Bridge is no longer taking place after Trump announced a 50% tariff on Canadian goodsA planned joint US-Canada ceremony Friday celebrating the opening of the Gordie Howe International Bridge connecting Detroit and Windsor, Ontario, is no longer expected to take place after Donald Trump announced a 50% tariff on most Canadian goods.

articles.title: Iran Continues Executions Amid Protest By Death Row Inmates
articles.summary: Iran executed a man it accused of carrying out "operational actions" during nationwide protests at the start of the year as the country's leadership ratchets up its crackdown on dissent, sparking a hunger strike among hundreds of death row inmates. Iran Continues Executions Amid Protest By Death Row Inmates.

articles.title: Nicaragua’s congress announces ‘work plan’ to suspend elections
articles.summary: US secretary of state says international community should ‘join forces’ against authoritarian Ortega regimeNicaragua’s congress, controlled by the country’s long-serving president, Daniel Ortega, has announced a “work plan” to implement the authoritarian leader’s order that the country should no longer hold elections. The UN and the US strongly condemned Sunday’s announcement by Ortega, who has bee Nicaragua’s congress announces ‘work plan’ to suspend elections.

articles.title: Rubio Says Iran-Backed Houthis' Red Sea Blockade 'Problematic'
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ‌said on July 22 that a naval blockade of the Red Sea by Yemen’s Houthi rebels would be “problematic,” as the widening conflict with Iran disrupted two of the world’s most important energy chokepoints. Rubio Says Iran-Backed Houthis' Red Sea Blockade 'Problematic'.

articles.title: Sperm whales change ‘vowel’ sounds when boats are nearby, scientists discover
articles.summary: Researchers listening off the Caribbean island of Dominica found variations in the mammals’ audible clicks when marine traffic was closeSperm whales produce a specific pattern of clicking noises when they hear the noise of boats, researchers have found. The pattern is so distinct that the scientists who identified it said they can now use it to predict when ships are nearby.

articles.title: Deadly Afghanistan floods kill at least 26 as aid agencies race to reach survivors
articles.summary: Flash floods have killed at least 26 people across eastern Afghanistan, including 23 in the mountainous province of Nuristan, where homes, markets and roads were swept away and search teams continued looking for people reported missing. Deadly Afghanistan floods kill at least 26 as aid agencies race to reach survivors.

articles.summary: अमेरिका में नया भारतीय दूतावास व्यापार और निवेश के लिए 'सुपर मिशन' बन गया है, जो सेमीकंडक्टर और क्रिटिकल मिनरल्स की सप्लाई चेन को सुरक्षित बनाने पर काम कर रहा है. अमेरिका के लॉस एंजिल्स में खुला नया भारतीय दूतावास अब सिर्फ पासपोर्ट-वीजा बांटने तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि ये व्यापार, निवेश और तकनीक के एक नए 'सुपर मिशन' के रूप में उभर चुका है.

articles.title: ईरान ने फिर किया कुवैत पर हमला, दागे ताबड़तोड़ ड्रोन्स
articles.summary: ईरान (Iran) और अमेरिका (United States of America) के बीच तनाव की वजह से दोनों देश एक-दूसरे के सैन्य और अन्य ठिकानों पर हमले कर रहे हैं। अमेरिका ने लगातार पिछली 12 रात ईरान पर हमले किए हैं, जिसके जवाब में ईरान ने भी मिडिल ईस्ट में अमेरिका के सहयोगी देशों अब तक कई हमले किए हैं। इन देशों में कुवैत (Kuwait) भी शामिल हैं जिसे लगातार ईरान के हमले झेलने पड़ रहे हैं।

articles.title: कारगिल की साज़िश के 4 चेहरे... आखिर कौन था पाकिस्तान का 'Gang of Four'?
